item.endrem.old_eye.description: §7§oBuried with the Pharaoh, who swore to watch over the desert until the end of days
item.endrem.evil_eye.description: §7§oA holy talisman against bad luck, hidden behind a hundred traps in the jungle temples
item.endrem.lost_eye.description: §7§oForged by the first blacksmiths in the fires of the Foundry, and lost among its furnaces
item.endrem.black_eye.description: §7§oIt gave sight to the legendary Black Pearl. Pirate captains still fight over it
item.endrem.cold_eye.description: §7§oThe Iceologers sealed it in ice before they vanished: in the Frostbitten Temple and some igloo cellars
item.endrem.wither_eye.description: §7§oHas witnessed destruction. Maybe it also witnessed your stuff disappear
item.endrem.guardian_eye.description: §7§oIt has seen many warriors drown. The Elder Guardian keeps it in the ocean monument
item.endrem.cursed_eye.description: §7§oIgnis swore to guard it in the Burning Arena, and the oath burned itself into him
item.endrem.nether_eye.description: §7§oLost by a demon in the war between the Aether and the Nether, now locked in the Netherite Monstrosity's forge-heart
item.endrem.corrupted_eye.description: §7§oThe eye of a greedy king, wired into the Harbinger by those who wanted his fortune
item.endrem.rogue_eye.description: §7§oThe machine eye that taught our ancestors Redstone. Only a working factory can forge another
item.endrem.magical_eye.description: §7§oWithout this eye the Evoker has no power. Bound by an enchanter, woken with source
item.endrem.undead_eye.description: §7§oRemembrance of the past lives of those who live in death. A spare eye
item.endrem.witch_eye.description: §7§oIt saw the ancient brewing recipes lost in time. A spare eye
item.endrem.exotic_eye.description: §7§oThose who followed it found Atlantis and were never seen again. A spare eye
item.endrem.cryptic_eye.description: §7§oThe sixteenth eye. No one has ever found it
